criteria.rationale: The patient was 49 years old on the 2026-09-01 request date.
The request is for Wegovy for chronic weight management.
The latest structured BMI before the request date is 31.5 kg/m², meeting the BMI ≥30 threshold.
Dietitian-led program intake and follow-up document participation in a reduced-calorie eating plan, food logging, and walking.

Although an older Ozempic order remains marked active, the newer clinical note explicitly says it was stopped about two months earlier and is not currently taken. The draft Wegovy order is excluded from concurrent therapy.
No concurrent medication from the policy's Appendix 2 weight-loss list is documented; Ozempic is not on that list and was also reported stopped. The draft Wegovy order is excluded.
